fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek Q3 revenue of NT$16.806 billion grew 18.3% YoY, with initial AI accelerator shipments expected to drive Q4 revenue growth of 25-32% annualized, targeting approximately $16B AI accelerator revenue in 2027 with 20% ASIC market share.
fields.summary_ko.1: Smart Edge Platform grew 63% YoY and accounted for 58% of revenue, with mobile phone revenue declining 17%, increasing importance of AI business diversification, with second-generation accelerator scheduled for mass production in Q1 2028.
